en: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

p.src: 16  So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

en: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

p.src: 17  Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?
